basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas, who recently got into gaming, especially Destiny 2. My main interests include renewable energy technologies and online multiplayer games. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 6-9 PM CST. I'm currently single and enjoy exploring different subreddits to learn and engage with communities related to my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and work for a tech startup focused on clean energy solutions. Most of my gaming knowledge comes from self-teaching and following gaming communities online.
